description: Captain Pike returns to the Enterprise and leads a new five-year mission while living with knowledge of his future and confronting the Gorn threat.

s01e01.description: Pike returns to the Enterprise to rescue a missing officer while wrestling with foreknowledge of the accident that awaits him.

s01e02.description: The Enterprise tries to divert a comet from an inhabited world while zealots guard an alien relic embedded in the ice.

s01e03.description: A light-driven contagion spreads through the ship, forcing Una to confront the genetic secret she has hidden from Starfleet.

s01e04.description: A rescue mission becomes a deadly encounter with the Gorn, requiring Pike and his crew to survive an enemy that fights without mercy.

s01e05.description: Spock and T'Pring attempt to understand each other through an ill-timed body swap while Pike conducts delicate negotiations.

s01e06.description: Pike reunites with a former love on an apparently idyllic world whose prosperity depends on a disturbing hidden cost.

s01e07.description: A humanitarian mission is hijacked by pirates, leaving the Enterprise crew trapped in a struggle over the ship and Spock.

s01e08.description: An alien consciousness turns the Enterprise into a living fairy tale, with only M'Benga aware that his crewmates are playing assigned roles.

s01e09.description: A stranded landing party faces the Gorn on a barren world, turning a rescue into a brutal fight for survival.

s01e10.description: Pike is shown a future created by avoiding his own fate and must decide whether saving himself would endanger far more lives.
